title: OpenAPI Events — global speaker registry
description: data/speakers/speakers.yaml — the single source of truth for every speaker. Events reference these entries by slug; per-event files under data/<year>/<slug>/speakers/speakers.yaml override individual fields (see speakers.override.schema.json). Resolved by src/lib/speakers.ts.

allOf.$comment: Registry entries must carry a name; without one the UI falls back to rendering the raw slug. Per-event overrides reuse $defs/entry directly, where name is optional.

slug.description: Stable identifier used everywhere a speaker is referenced. Also names the published photo, /img/speakers/<slug>.webp.

name.description: Display name. Stable identity — never overridden per event.

role.description: Job title. Rendered as "role | company"; taken as a matched pair with `company` from the speaker's most recent event.

company.description: Latest-known affiliation. Point-in-time affiliation for a given event belongs in that event's speakers/speakers.yaml override.

image.description: A bare filename resolves to data/speakers/image/<file>, published to /img/speakers/<slug>.webp by `npm run speakers`. A full URL or a site-absolute /path is used verbatim. Omit it and the speaker gets the neutral committed avatar.

badges.description: Membership pills shown after the name. Uppercased on render; unknown codes still show, they just get no tooltip.

urls.description: External links, rendered as icons next to the speaker. A speaker with no `urls` shows no icons — nothing is guessed from the name. Merged as a whole list per event, not entry by entry.
urls.$comment: if/then rather than oneOf so a bad link reports against the shape actually written instead of a branch mismatch.

id.description: Picks the icon and the default accessible label. linkedin, github and x have marks; twitter/site/homepage are aliases; anything else falls back to a globe. Defaults to "website" when omitted.

url.description: Used verbatim as the href. An entry without one is dropped rather than rendered as a dead anchor.

name.description: Overrides the default label when the generic one reads wrong.
